dispositions.evidence: All three role packages now stop on Scope.omitted_files (rule omitted-diff) or issue a retrieval request before any verdict.
Contract lens carries the omitted-files stop rule and reads omitted_files in its procedure.
Security lens carries the omitted-files stop rule and reads omitted_files in its procedure.
record.load_review_lens refuses a stop-block document (render and check); the bench loader refuses a stopped lens instead of scoring zero.
Per-file diffs run under --literal-pathspecs; a star-named file no longer selects siblings or withheld files.
The truncated-input stop rule landed in 0939325 (all three role packages, rule truncated-input); c70bb5e carries the package-side evidence-surface changes this finding's anchor cites.
Scope lists binary_files explicitly; the role packages refuse to count a binary block as reviewed (rule binary-unavailable).
Empty or whitespace-only --include values are refused by name instead of packaging the whole diff.
Incomplete diffs are explicit in Scope (omitted_files) and the role packages refuse a verdict on them (rule omitted-diff, 0939325); c70bb5e carries the package-side surface change this anchor cites.
REVIEW-S3.5a.md totals are derived from the two record JSONs: 4 blockers, 25 majors, 7 minors; 28 fixed, 3 rejected, 5 deferred.
findings.load raises FindingsError naming the file and decode problem; both CLI commands exit 1 with no traceback.
changed_statuses and numstat_rows use -z and parse NUL-delimited records; quoted/backslash paths get real diffs and correct matching.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): The builder omits whole files in Scope.omitted_files when the diff cap is exceeded; it does not place a truncation marker in the Diff section, so the stop rule never fires and the lens can approve without seeing the omitted hunks.
findings.required_change: Require retrieval or a stop whenever Scope.omitted_files is non-empty, before producing a verdict.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): Same omission surface in the contract lens: omitted files are listed only in Scope, so the truncation stop rule never fires.
findings.required_change: Add the omitted-files stop/retrieval rule to the contract lens.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): Same omission surface in the security lens: omitted files are listed only in Scope, so the truncation stop rule never fires.
findings.required_change: Add the omitted-files stop/retrieval rule to the security lens.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): The valid stop shape is treated as an empty findings list by record.load_review_lens, and compose_record consequently produces APPROVED; check repeats that conversion. A panel that stopped on a package hash mismatch can yield a checked approval.
findings.required_change: Preserve the stop state and refuse to render/check a record when any lens stopped; the bench loader must not score a stopped lens as zero findings.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): path is passed to Git as a pathspec, not a literal filename. A changed file named src/*.py also selects src/secret.py, so that file's diff can be embedded even when removed by the withheld/allowed filters.
findings.required_change: Use a literal pathspec for each per-file diff.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): A contract or gate input exceeding the cap is silently shortened apart from the inline marker, but the role packages have no stop or retrieval rule for truncated inputs, so a reviewer can approve against only the beginning of the spec.
findings.required_change: Refuse truncated required inputs or require retrieval/stop in the role contracts before a verdict.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): Binary diffs are replaced with [binary] but are not listed as omitted and do not trigger any lens stop rule, so a changed binary can get an approval though its contents were never reviewable.
findings.required_change: List binary files explicitly and make them unavailable evidence that requires retrieval or a stopped review.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): An empty or whitespace-only --include becomes an empty list, which skips filtering and packages all changed files while Scope still displays an empty included_paths list.
findings.required_change: Reject empty include values so an invalid restrictive scope cannot disclose the entire diff.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): When the byte cap omits files, their names appear only in Scope with no truncation marker in Diff; all three role packages look for a marker in Diff, so they can approve a package without reviewing any omitted file.
findings.required_change: Make incomplete diffs force retrieval or a stop before a verdict, and align the package and role instructions.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): The self-review totals do not match the two committed round-1 records: code has 3/15/4 severities and 19/1/2 dispositions, content has 1/10/3 and 9/2/3; five findings were deferred, not three.
findings.required_change: Derive the summary table from the records so the owner reads accurate numbers.

findings.evidence: External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): A findings file containing invalid UTF-8 raises UnicodeDecodeError, which is not an OSError or FindingsError, so both CLI commands print a traceback instead of the promised named refusal.

External review on PR #28 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer): Without -z, Git C-quotes paths containing quotes, backslashes, tabs or newlines; those quoted strings are then used as file paths, so the per-file diff is empty and allowed/withheld matching uses the wrong name.
findings.required_change: Request NUL-delimited output and decode the actual paths in both changed_statuses and numstat_rows.
